newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Palawan authorises property swap with PRCI.
newsitem.headline: Palawan authorises property swap with PRCI.

text.p: Palawan Consolidated Mining Co Inc said on Friday its board has authorised its officers to negotiate for a property-for-equity swap with racetrack operator Philippine Racing Club Inc (PRCI).
Palawan president John Anthony Espiritu has been authorised to negotiate for the terms of the swap plans with PRCI officials, Palawan corporate secretary Solomon Cua said in a statement.
In a separate statement, PRCI said its board also approved plans to spin-off its real estate properties through a share-swap agreement with Palawan or any other listed firm.
Neither firm disclosed other details of the proposed swap agreement.
